name: Blood Mage
description: A self-destructive dark spellcaster who draws power from her own suffering. She bleeds herself to fuel magic, weaponizes backbiting damage, and unlocks her most dangerous abilities only when endangered — a glass cannon who gets deadlier the closer she is to death.

mechanic.name: Cruor Magic
mechanic.text: The Blood Mage gains power from blood, and when she becomes endangered from her own blood loss, her power increases. She can unlock her most dangerous abilities only when her health is critically low.

Major: Causes bleed on target based on currently attuned element (Blood Mage)
High damage dark magic attack with backbiting (Blood Mage)
Magic attack against single that causes bleeding with backbiting (Blood Mage)
Dark magic attack with life drain and bleed. Requires dark and water attunement (Blood Mage)
Causes bleed of each attuned element. Requires 3 attunements (Blood Mage)
Magic attack with damage scaling linearly based on the Blood Mage's missing health (Blood Mage)
Magic untyped damage that repeats at the beginning of the unit's next turn; both hits deal backbiting damage to the Blood Mage (Blood Mage)
Dark magic attack against all enemies; gains life drain if Blood Mage is endangered (Blood Mage)
Corruption against single enemy; gains piercing if Blood Mage is endangered (Blood Mage)
Untyped countdown against single enemy; becomes corrupt countdown if Blood Mage is endangered (Blood Mage)
Afflicts single enemy with curse; also causes wound if Blood Mage is endangered (Blood Mage)
Single target life drain; stays prepared if Blood Mage is endangered (Blood Mage)
Magic attack that causes untyped bleed with reduced mana cost based on Spirit Power (Blood Mage)
Dark magic attack that drains life and generates Spirit Power. Requires endangered (Blood Mage)
Move: Gains enhanced defense and untyped retaliation. Follows killing an enemy (Blood Mage)
Gain mana surge based on highest bleed Blood Mage is suffering (Blood Mage)
Purge Blood Mage of afflictions. Requires endangered (Blood Mage)
Dark magic attack that drains life. Consumes dark attunement; requires endangered (Blood Mage)
Enhance magic damage for each bleed suffered (Blood Mage)
Weak dark life drain against single enemy that quickens cast of next spell (Blood Mage)
Minor: Dark damage add to next attack with backbiting (Blood Mage)
Sacrifices health to increase magic power of next attack (Blood Mage)
Gain Spirit Power based on highest bleed Blood Mage is suffering (Blood Mage)
Become immune to damage afflictions until next turn. Requires endangered (Blood Mage)
Enhance mana generation while constantly draining Spirit Power. Spirit buff (Blood Mage)

capstone.name: Blood is Mana
capstone.text: A portion of health is spent instead of mana to cast spells.

passives: Backbiting increases the damage of backbiting abilities.  It does not affect damage dealt to the unit for using them.
Dark piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s dark resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Light resistance lowers the effectiveness of light abilities on the target.
Bleed damage increases the value of bleed effects used by the unit.
Life drain increases the damage dealt and the life restored by any life drain effect.
Damage resistance reduces the chance for the unit to be affected by damage afflictions.
Mana cost reduced reduces the amount of mana all abilities require to use.
Corrupt damage increases the value of all sources of corrupt damage the unit deals.
Cast speed reduces the delay used by preparation abilities.
Starting mana increases the amount of mana a unit has at the beginning of battle.
Healing received increases the value of all healing effects targeting the unit.

name: Faith Healer
description: A cursed healer who turns purging into a weapon. She applies malediction to prime enemies for devastating purge payoffs, spreads afflictions between foes, and generates divinity through the same heals and purges that dismantle enemy debuff stacks — rewarding aggressive support play over passive restoration.

mechanic.name: Weaponized Purges
mechanic.text: The Faith Healer can purge enemies of their afflictions and in return cause much worse conditions for her foes.

Major: Purges an enemy of all damage afflictions then damages all enemies for each affliction purged (Faith Healer)
Purges an enemy of all afflictions then damages the enemy for each affliction purged (Faith Healer)
Drains all enemies based on divinity and heals ally with lowest health (Faith Healer)
Water bleed against single target that deals remaining damage if it is purged (Faith Healer)
Dark damage and damage weakness versus all maledicted (Faith Healer)
Light magic attack with light countdown against single enemy (Faith Healer)
Drains from each maledicted enemy to heal target (Faith Healer)
Light magic attack that causes malediction (Faith Healer)
Purge enemy of all afflictions and deal light damage and cause light exposure for each affliction removed (Faith Healer)
Light bleed against target enemy that damages all enemies if it is purged (Faith Healer)
Purge enemy of all afflictions except malediction, then spread those afflictions to all other enemies (Faith Healer)
Move: Lowers damage of all enemies. Can be sustained (Faith Healer)
Purge enemy and afflict it with malediction and dark countdown. Target must be afflicted (Faith Healer)
Afflict target enemy with damage weakness and defense weakness. Causes brittle and blunts next attack if purged (Faith Healer)
Transfer affliction from Faith Healer to target enemy. Requires endangered (Faith Healer)
Target enemy's damage is minimized until it is attacked. Generates divinity (Faith Healer)
Grants ally intangible. Generates divinity (Faith Healer)
Unlucky accuracy for next attack for all maledicted (Faith Healer)
Minor: Next time target suffers an affliction, purge a different affliction (Faith Healer)
Purge and disenchant enemy or ally (Faith Healer)
Purge enemy and drain mana based on affliction purged (Faith Healer)
Next time target gains an enchantment, disenchant a different enchantment (Faith Healer)
Purge enemy and lower affliction resistance based on affliction purged (Faith Healer)

Increases affliction power of all allies. Requires minimum divinity and consumes divinity each turn. Generates divinity when enemies lose afflictions with turn-based durations. Lasts as long as divinity stays above minimum. (Faith Healer)
Grant regeneration to ally suffering from corruption (Faith Healer)

capstone.name: Redirected Maladies
capstone.text: Whenever she purges an affliction, she gains increased affliction power.

passives: Enchant power increases the value of all enchant abilities used by the unit.
Reduced affliction duration reduces the duration of any afflictions affecting the unit by a percentage.
Purge power increases the chance for the character to remove afflictions with its purges.

Water power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the water tag.
Glancing damage received lowers the damage taken by hits taken by the unit classified as glancing.

name: Guardian
description: The most defensively oriented class in the game, sacrificing nearly all offense for impenetrable protection. He combines the Knight's guard relationship with the Monk's chakra system to absorb, redirect, and punish incoming damage — closing chakras as a shield resource and building passive defense through deliberate restraint.

mechanic.name: Pacifism
mechanic.text: The Guardian takes many turns without actively damaging his foes.  In return, his defenses and his capability for defending allies improves during these turns.

Major: Melee attack that blunts target's next attack (Guardian)
Close all chakras and prevent all damage for the next x attacks based on number of chakras closed (Guardian)
Prepared ability; Knight and guarded ally both counter the next attack against the guarded ally. Guarded ally acts for free (Guardian)
Melee attack that lowers target's dodge (Guardian)
Earth melee attack versus all that causes prone. Requires threshold (Guardian)
Clobbering melee attack requiring Leopard form (Guardian)
Counter next attack against ally with a justice modifier (Guardian)
Guarded target cannot take damage until Guardian's next turn. Does not prevent afflictions or damage from afflictions (Guardian)
Grants all allies fortified and earth damage adds until start of Guardian's next turn (Guardian)
Provokes all enemies and establishes one-way pain link with one target, dealing a portion of all damage dealt to the Guardian to that enemy (Guardian)
Taunt; reflect next damage to all enemies (Guardian)

Close all chakras when next damaged. For each chakra closed, prevent one fifth of damage (Guardian)

capstone.name: Martial Patience
capstone.text: The Guardian builds stacking defense on turns where no damage-dealing ability is used. All stacks are lost when the Guardian uses a damage-dealing ability. Counters and reactions do not remove stacks.

passives: Ignore prone gives the unit a chance to ignore any prone effect caused on them.
Ignore compels gives the unit a chance to target any enemy even if one enemy is affected by the compel condition.

Spell dodge provides a unit an opportunity to lower the effects or avoid entirely magic attacks.
Earth power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the earth tag.

name: Mesmerist
description: A hypnotic controller who locks enemies in place through sustained channeling. She combines the Bard's audience manipulation with the Psychic's influence system, using set-duration channels that build powerful end-of-channel payoffs — rewarding patience and disruption resistance over raw damage output.

mechanic.name: Channel Payoffs
mechanic.text: The Mesmerists has multiple channel abilities that have an additional effect that only triggers on the end of channeling.  If he is interrupted before then, he does not get the benefit.

Major: Channeled ability that distracts all enemies each tick; damages enemy if it is disrupted during channel (Mesmerist)
Costs mana; blind and distract all enemies, gain hidden (Mesmerist)
Channels for set duration causing water damage each tick; applies slow to target at end of channel (Mesmerist)
Magic water attack against influenced enemy enhanced by influence
Channels for set duration causing water damage each tick; water damage burst against all enemies at end of channel (Mesmerist)

Afflict target enemy with water countdown (Mesmerist)
Ranged attack that stuns target and adds them to audience (Mesmerist)

Water power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the water tag.
Illusory damage increases the value of all sources of illusory damage.
Disruption resistance lowers the chance to lose focus while enchanted with it and for spells to be disrupted while they are prepared.

Conserve focus grants a unit a chance to not lose focus when it prevents disruption or is used for an ability.
Water piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s water resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Weakness power increases the value of weakness effects used by the unit.
Initial defense reduces the damage taken by unit from each attack before its first action each wave.

name: Ranger
description: A versatile skirmisher who fights equally well at melee and ranged distance. He builds accuracy stacks by alternating between sword and bow, with each weapon type setting up the other — a class built around deliberate rhythm rather than specialization.

mechanic.name: Alternating Combat
mechanic.text: The Ranger builds accuracy stacks by alternating between melee and ranged attacks, with each weapon type setting up the other. His kit mirrors across both ranges, rewarding deliberate rhythm over pure specialization.

Major: Ranged attack that grants extra damage to next melee attack (Ranger)
Alternating melee and ranged attacks with high accuracy (Ranger)
Ranged storm attack that consumes expertise (Ranger)
Multi-modal; each use alternates between a ranged attack that cannot target enemies in the first row and a powerful melee attack against the same target (Ranger)

name: Shock Trooper
description: An air-powered melee fighter who weaponizes her own forcefield. She drains her damage shield through Intensify abilities to deliver air attacks, control effects, and retaliatory damage — spending defense as offense and regenerating it through combat aggression.

mechanic.name: Intensify
mechanic.text: The Shock Trooper weaponizes her own damage shield through Intensify abilities, which drain the damage shield as a cost to deliver powerful air attacks and control effects.

Major: Initial Effect: High damage against target. Basic Effect: Gain amplification versus challenge. Challenge Effect: Use amplification against challenge (Shock Trooper)
Melee attack with amplification that consumes ammo; also applies amplification to damage adds from ammo. Amplification resets on reload (Shock Trooper)
Air melee attack with amplification. Drains damage shield (Shock Trooper)
Melee attack that causes bleed with penetration. Bleed type is based on current ammo (Shock Trooper)

Air elemental melee attack versus challenge (Shock Trooper)

Whenever damage shield is destroyed or disenchanted, Shock Trooper counters the enemy that caused this (Shock Trooper)
Grants target a proc that increases damage shield on attack (Shock Trooper)
Taunt target enemy and gain damage shield equal to damage of next hit received, lasting for a standard duration (Shock Trooper)
Grants air retaliation to Shock Trooper with amplification. Drains damage shield (Shock Trooper)
Stuns all enemies based on amplification. Drains damage shield (Shock Trooper)
Minor: Gain barrier against next attack (Shock Trooper)
Gain damage shield at the beginning of next turn based on air damage taken before next turn (Shock Trooper)
Delay all enemies. Drain damage shield (Shock Trooper)
Next Intensify ability drains more damage shield for a greater effect (Shock Trooper)
Provoke all enemies; deal air damage to challenge when next damaged (Shock Trooper)
Gain damage shield that is lost after next time damaged (Shock Trooper)
Stun and delay all enemies that attack before next turn. Requires damage shield (Shock Trooper)

classSkills: Challenge Bonus, Elemental Resist versus Challenged

capstone.name: Sparking Forcefield
capstone.text: Whenever the Shock Trooper loses a threshold amount of damage shield, she deals air damage to a random enemy. The threshold resets after triggering.

passives: Critical damage increases the damage dealt by any critical hit.
Amplification increases the bonus gained by repeatedly using amplification abilities.  This has no impact on the initial use.

name: Summoner
description: A versatile conjurer who supplements traditional companion play with powerful Calling abilities that channel summon energy directly. He combines Binder alignment management with Runemage rune customization to enhance and vary his companions, with Lingering Essence rewarding rapid Calling chains and smooth transitions between summons.

mechanic.name: Calling
mechanic.text: Calling abilities channel summon power directly without a companion present, providing powerful effects.

Major: Next enemy to attack takes damage and is delayed and incapacitated (Summoner)
Earth magic attack versus all enemies that cannot be countered and benefits from companion passives. Requires no companion present (Summoner)
Element rune; magic dark damage and blind versus all (Summoner)
Fire magic attack versus all enemies that cannot be countered and benefits from companion passives. Requires no companion present (Summoner)
Prepared; costs mana. Summons a temporary companion for each ally with an empty companion slot; all attack immediately then expire at end of turn (Summoner)
Light magic attack versus all enemies that cannot be countered and benefits from companion passives; also heals team. Requires no companion present (Summoner)
Temporary companion based on current power and damage runes (Summoner)
Consumes one primed rune of each type (power, elemental, defense); summons a companion based on the combination (Summoner)
Untyped countdown that generates Thanatos on end (Summoner)
Earth magic attack versus all enemies that cannot be countered and benefits from companion passives; also slows and delays all enemies. Requires no companion present (Summoner)
Summons a tupilaq companion. Tupilaqs gain greater effects from runes and procs (Summoner)
Move: Companion gains additional earth damage with attacks; reserves mana (Summoner)
Next enemy to attack Summoner causes Eros gain and mana gain (Summoner)
Heals master of any targeted companion whenever that companion attacks (Summoner)
Enchant rune that reduces mana cost and improves cast speed of summons (Summoner)
Next enemy to attack Summoner causes Thanatos gain and quicken cast (Summoner)
Defense rune that causes fire damage to all enemies when hit (Summoner)
Minor: Moves alignment towards balanced to reduce cost of next summon (Summoner)
Follow summon with damage based on summon (Summoner)
Companion counters any attack made against it or Summoner before its first turn (Summoner)
Transfer runes from self to companion (Summoner)
Greatly enhance summoning speed. Requires summon present (Summoner)

capstone.text: For two turns after any companion leaves the battlefield, the Summoner gains increased magic power and summoning power.

name: Thug
description: A brutal opportunist who sets up stuns and flanks to land devastating follow-up strikes. He combines Barbarian rage with Rogue advantage to exploit enemy vulnerability — stunning enemies to generate resources, quickening himself through Cruel Momentum when enemies lose their turns, and hitting hardest when foes are most helpless.

mechanic.text: The Thug uses multiple abilities that stun her enemies and multiple abilities that take advantage of that same stunned condition.

Melee attack against stunned that generates advantage (Thug)
Attack, stun target and self, omega (Thug)

Melee attack that flanks enemy on critical (Thug)

Melee attack with delay against flanked target (Thug)
Afflict target enemy with poison that causes tired (Thug)

Generate rage for each stunned enemy (Thug)

capstone.name: Cruel Momentum

passives: Clobbering increases the clobber value of clobbering abilities.
Tired duration increases the value and duration of any tired and exhausted effects used by the unit and reduces any effect of tired on the unit.
Stun duration increases the duration of stun effects caused by the unit.
Ignore glancing gives the unit a chance to take no damage from an attack that would otherwise deal glancing damage.

name: Beastmaster
description: Pack-commanding warrior who fights alongside a growing menagerie. He fuses the Barbarian's Anguish-driven aggression with the Binder's companion system, pushing his beasts harder as his rage builds — and hits hardest when his pack is largest.

mechanic.name: Pack Commander
mechanic.text: The Beastmaster coordinates a pack of companions alongside her own combat presence, with Anguish and Thanatos fueling the aggression of both herself and her beasts. Companion count and strength directly enhance several of her abilities.

Major: Summons a bear companion that gains increased damage and defense as it takes damage. (Beastmaster)
The Beastmaster and her companion attack the same target simultaneously. Requires Berserk. (Beastmaster)

Quickens all companions but deals them damage. (Beastmaster)

capstone.text: The Beastmaster's attacks deal increased damage for each companion currently present on the battlefield.

His device funds protective shrine companions and warranty effects that shield enchantments from removal.

Major: Consumes all ammo to summon a companion that grants offensive enchantments to allies each turn. Power and duration scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Enchanter)
Ranged attack with damage based on the number of enchantments disenchanted from any unit since the Enchanter's last turn. (Enchanter)
Ranged note that adds the target to the audience and afflicts it with an untyped countdown. (Enchanter)
Ranged attack that requires the Enchanter to be enchanted. Power scales with the number of enchantments currently on the Enchanter. (Enchanter)
Disenchants all enchantments currently on the Enchanter and deals magic damage to all enemies based on the total value of enchantments consumed. (Enchanter)
Copies all enchantments currently on a single ally to all other allies. (Enchanter)
Water magic storm attack that makes one strike per enchantment currently present on the Enchanter. (Enchanter)
Consumes all ammo to summon a companion that grants defensive enchantments to allies each turn. Power and duration scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Enchanter)
Refrain that afflicts all enemies in the audience with an untyped countdown. (Enchanter)
The Enchanter loses a random enchantment currently on himself to deal damage to a single enemy. (Enchanter)
Refrain that afflicts all enemies in the audience with a water countdown. (Enchanter)
Move: Spends one ammo to grant a barrier to the target ally. (Enchanter)
Sacrifices all enchantments currently on the Enchanter to heal and purge all allies. The power of the heal and purge scales with the total value of enchantments consumed. (Enchanter)

Places an enchantment trap on a target ally. When the trap expires naturally, it heals the target. If the trap is removed for any reason other than duration expiration, it deals water damage to all enemies instead. (Enchanter)
Dischord that causes enchantments on enemies in the audience to expire at twice the normal rate. (Enchanter)
Enchants a target ally with a countdown that restores mana when it activates. (Enchanter)
Refreshes the remaining duration of each enchantment currently on the target. (Enchanter)
Chord that grants increased enchantment potency, power, and duration to allied audience members. (Enchanter)
Minor: Shares a random enchantment currently on the Enchanter with all allies. Requires the contagion condition. (Enchanter)
Spends one ammo to prevent the next disenchantment effect against the target ally. (Enchanter)
Purges the forsaken condition from a single target ally. (Enchanter)
All allies gain increased disenchant resistance until the Enchanter's next turn. (Enchanter)
When a target ally dies, the Enchanter gains all enchantments that were present on that ally at the time of death. (Enchanter)
A target ally loses one random enchantment and is healed for a value based on the enchantment sacrificed. (Enchanter)

capstone.name: Overwhelm Forsaken
capstone.text: Whenever the Enchanter targets an ally afflicted with forsaken with an enchantment ability, he has a chance to apply the enchantment despite the forsaken condition.

passives: Enchant potency reduces the chance for enchants used by the unit to be disenchanted.
Enchant duration increases the duration of enchant effects used by the unit.
Enchant power increases the value of all enchant abilities used by the unit.
Disenchant resistance lowers the chance for any disenchant effects to work against the unit.
Countdown power increases the value of countdown effects used by the unit.
Water piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s water resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Amplification increases the bonus gained by repeatedly using amplification abilities.  This has no impact on the initial use.
Barrier threshold reduces the amount of damage that triggers barrier, reducing the maximum damage taken from attacks.
Mana reserved lowers the amount of mana reserved by prepared abilities by a given percentage.
Arcane power increases the effect of magical abilities that do not have an elemental tag.
Weakness power increases the value of weakness effects used by the unit.
Initiative gives a unit a base timer value at the start of battles and waves.
Mana generation increases the amount of mana gained each tick.

name: Esoteric
description: A tandem fighter who fights in concert with a spirit companion. He chains counters into companion quickens and damage bonuses, shapes his companion's element through his current form, and bridges alignment tools with the chakra ladder — Eros enhancing chance, Thanatos enhancing damage.

Major: Melee attack against the target and one random additional enemy. Flanks both targets. (Esoteric)
Melee attack that enhances dodge. Requires crane form and lowers form on use. If the Esoteric dodges before his next turn, he returns to crane form. (Esoteric)
Melee attack against the target. If the target attacks the Esoteric before his next turn, the Esoteric is guaranteed to counter. Requires focus. (Esoteric)

Melee attack requiring dragon form. On use, the Esoteric arms an automatic counter, if triggered, it deals damage and stuns all enemies, with both effects scaling with the number of open chakras. Raises form to mantis if the counter fires; lowers form to monkey if no counter occurs. (Esoteric)
The Esoteric and his companion each make a powerful attack against the target enemy simultaneously. Requires and removes intangible from the companion. (Esoteric)
Melee attack that enhances critical chance and counter chance if Eros-aligned, or critical damage and counter damage if Thanatos-aligned. (Esoteric)

Prepared reaction. When the Esoteric is next attacked, he counters with bonus damage based on how much damage the triggering attack dealt. If that attack would have killed him, the counter damage is further increased. Consumes enduring. (Esoteric)
Melee attack with decimate. Requires the Esoteric to be intangible. On a miss, the Esoteric loses intangible. (Esoteric)
Prepared melee attack that generates mana on hit. On a critical hit, inhibits the mana of all opponents and deals additional damage based on the mana they lose. (Esoteric)
Prepared reaction. When the Esoteric is next attacked, he counters and summons a mirror image companion that lasts for a short period. (Esoteric)
Melee attack that causes earth bleed and damage weakness. Requires snake form and raises form on use. If the Esoteric counters before his next turn, he returns to snake form. (Esoteric)
Melee attack made immediately following the companion being attacked. (Esoteric)
Move: Enhances the Esoteric's defense. If the Esoteric is hit before his next turn, he assumes monkey form. (Esoteric)
The Esoteric's next counter also quickens the companion and enhances its damage. (Esoteric)
Prepared ability. Grants all allies intangible. Requires Thanatos alignment. Costs mana. (Esoteric)
Grants the companion a damage type based on the Esoteric's current form. (Esoteric)
Restores mana to both the Esoteric and the companion when the Esoteric counters. (Esoteric)
Requires monkey form. If the Esoteric is currently hidden, he gains intangible at the beginning of his turn. If he is not hidden, he gains hidden instead. (Esoteric)
Minor: Instead of countering the next attack, the Esoteric gains focus and is quickened. (Esoteric)
Following the Esoteric's next counter, compels the target of that counter to attack the companion. (Esoteric)
The Esoteric's next counter also triggers a simultaneous counter from the companion. Delays both the Esoteric and the companion. (Esoteric)
Following the Esoteric's next counter, he restores mana. (Esoteric)
Sacrifices the Esoteric's focus to command the companion to make an attack. (Esoteric)
Grants the companion intangible for a period. (Esoteric)

classSkills: Alignment Trigger, Eros, Heal Self and Regen
Alignment Focus, Eros Magic Resistance/Thanatos Magic Power

capstone.name: Companion Attack Counter
capstone.text: Whenever the companion is attacked, the Esoteric has a chance to counter on the companion's behalf.

passives: Counter chance increases the chance for the unit to counter attacks made against it.
Counter damage increases the damage dealt by counter attacks used by the unit.
Companion damage increases the damage of a summoned companion.  Companion damage has a greater increase than companion power.
Break limit counter increases the maximum counter chance able to be gained by a unit.

Alone damage increases the damage of the unit when it is the last unit left alive.

name: Hexblade
description: A dark melee specialist who combines challenge focus with permanent malediction. She layers hexes onto her challenge through dark slashes, spreads afflictions via contagion, and punishes enemies for attacking her by countering with additional curses.

Major: Melee attack that spreads a random affliction from the target to adjacent enemies and causes contagion on the target. (Hexblade)
Initial Effect: Afflicts target with a dark hex. Basic Effect: Triggers the hex on the challenge. Challenge Effect: Amplifies and extends the hex on the target. (Hexblade)
Melee attack against a maledicted target that incapacitates it. (Hexblade)
Initial Effect: Establishes a heal siphon against the target. Basic Effect: Melee attack with a chance to proc drain. Challenge Effect: Melee attack with drain. (Hexblade)
Melee attack that procs dark exposure on the target. (Hexblade)
Prepared melee attack with a powerful dark damage add. Deals increased damage if the target is the challenge, maledicted, or both — each condition applies and stacks independently. (Hexblade)
Melee attack that causes malediction on the target. (Hexblade)
Melee attack against a maledicted target that causes corruption. (Hexblade)
Melee attack that weakens the target’s dark resistance and affliction resistance. (Hexblade)
Melee attack against a corrupted enemy. On kill, afflicts all remaining enemies with corruption. (Hexblade)
Incapacitates the challenge target, then triggers all hexes and contagion on it with the insidious modifier. (Hexblade)
Melee attack that grants the Hexblade a proc on her next attack causing it to spread one of the target’s current afflictions to adjacent enemies. (Hexblade)
Move: Dark magic attack against the challenge. (Hexblade)
The challenge gains a random affliction currently affecting the Hexblade. (Hexblade)
Follows killing an enemy. The Hexblade gains a dark damage add to attacks for a period. (Hexblade)
The Hexblade’s next counter is replaced with applying a dark hex to the attacker instead of making a physical counter. (Hexblade)
Grants a target ally a proc that applies a dark hex with their attacks. (Hexblade)
Melee attack against the maledicted target. (Hexblade)
Provokes all enemies currently suffering from malediction to attack the Hexblade. (Hexblade)
Minor: Taunts all enemies and the Hexblade cannot be disrupted until her next turn. Delays the Hexblade. (Hexblade)
If a hexed enemy attacks the Hexblade before her next turn, that enemy triggers its hex an additional time. (Hexblade)
If an enemy dies from hex damage before the Hexblade’s next turn, she gains mana and enhanced affliction power. (Hexblade)
Triggers all hexes and contagion on an incapacitated enemy with the insidious modifier. (Hexblade)
Triggers the hex on a target enemy and taunts it to attack the Hexblade. (Hexblade)
The challenge gains affliction resistance weakness until the end of the turn. (Hexblade)

classSkills: Challenge Bonus, Afflict Power versus Challenged
Challenge Bonus, Afflict Power versus Challenged

capstone.name: Hexblade's Mark
capstone.text: Whenever an enemy dies from hex damage, a random other enemy is afflicted with that hex.

Maledicted defense reduces the damage taken by the unit from any enemy afflicted with malediction.
Affliction potency reduces the chance for afflictions used by the unit to be purged.

name: Inquisitor
description: A divine marksman who locks onto a single target and prosecutes it with sustained trial abilities, generating aim through precision shooting and divinity through healing screens. He disenchants enemies, punishes corruption, and delivers justice-enhanced ranged strikes — with party-wide support benefits that persist as long as his focus holds.

Major: Ranged attack that deals additional damage based on the amount of corruption currently on the target. (Inquisitor)
Prepared ranged attack with decimation. Locks its target at time of preparation. Held until fired. (Inquisitor)
Prepared ranged ability that locks its target at time of preparation. On use, disenchants the target. (Inquisitor)
Makes a number of random ranged attacks based on current divinity, each of which disenchants its target. Consumes all divinity. (Inquisitor)
Ranged attack with justice and the pinpoint modifier. Consumes all divinity; both effects are enhanced by the total divinity spent. (Inquisitor)
Ranged attack against an illuminated target. Generates additional aim on hit. (Inquisitor)
Ranged attack with justice. Consumes aim; the justice effect is enhanced by aim spent. (Inquisitor)
Prepared ranged attack with justice. Locks its target at time of preparation. Held until fired. (Inquisitor)
Ranged fire attack that illuminates the target. (Inquisitor)
Ranged attack that applies affliction power weakness to the target on a critical hit. (Inquisitor)

Prepared ability that reserves mana. At the beginning of each of the Inquisitor’s turns, deals light damage to the trial target based on current divinity. Ends if the Inquisitor attacks a different enemy or is disrupted. (Inquisitor)

Prepared ability that reserves mana. Enhances the Inquisitor’s damage against the trial target based on current aim and justice value. Ends if the Inquisitor attacks a different enemy or is disrupted. (Inquisitor)
Move: The Inquisitor’s next attack deals additional light damage enhanced by current aim. (Inquisitor)
Ameliorates afflictions on the Inquisitor and generates aim. Must be used as the final action of the turn. (Inquisitor)
Prepared ability that reserves mana. Enhances all ally damage for as long as the trial is maintained. Ends if the Inquisitor attacks a different enemy or is disrupted. (Inquisitor)

Prepared ability that reserves mana. Heals all allies at the beginning of each of the Inquisitor’s turns for as long as the trial is maintained. Ends if the Inquisitor attacks a different enemy or is disrupted. (Inquisitor)
Prepared ability that reserves mana. Enhances all ally defense for as long as the trial is maintained. Ends if the Inquisitor attacks a different enemy or is disrupted. (Inquisitor)
Prepared ability that reserves mana. Enhances all ally affliction resistance for as long as the trial is maintained. Ends if the Inquisitor attacks a different enemy or is disrupted. (Inquisitor)
Minor: Disenchants the target, consuming aim based on the value of the enchantment removed. (Inquisitor)
Gains focus if a trial ability is currently active. (Inquisitor)

Reduces the duration of enemy enchantments at the beginning of each of the Inquisitor’s turns. Requires a minimum divinity to activate and consumes divinity each turn. Remains active as long as divinity stays above the minimum threshold. While active, generates divinity based on the pinpoint value or excess accuracy of the Inquisitor’s attacks. (Inquisitor)
Consumes one divinity to lower the target’s dodge and defense until the end of the turn. (Inquisitor)
Generates aim if the Inquisitor has been healed since his last turn. (Inquisitor)
Enhances the Inquisitor’s accuracy against the current trial target. (Inquisitor)

classSkills: Aim Amount, Aim when attacked by target

capstone.name: Trial Focus
capstone.text: The Inquisitor gains focus whenever he initiates a trial ability. This focus is lost when that trial ends.

Mental purge power increases the chance for purges to remove damage afflictions.  Mental purge power is more powerful than purge power.
Accuracy increases the chance for the unit to hit with ranged and melee attacks.
Distant damage increases the damage of any ability targeting enemies in the back row.  Distant abilities gain increased bonus.
Initial damage increases the damage dealt by the unit’s first action of each wave.

name: Judge
description: A guardian who responds to ally suffering with psychic retribution. She builds influence over enemies while guarding a chosen ally, punishes enemy aggression with possession and judgment strikes, and has a full suite of reactions that fire when allies die — making every enemy kill a costly decision.

Major: Light elemental melee attack that afflicts the target with a light hex and grants the Judge light retaliation. (Judge)
Transfers all illusory damage currently on the Judge to all enemies over which she has influence. (Judge)
Fire melee attack with increased damage against compelled enemies. (Judge)
Melee attack with justice, usable only following being attacked by the target since last turn. (Judge)
Physical magic attack against a single target that incapacitates it. (Judge)

Prepared melee attack reaction that fires after an ally dies, with the guarded ally making a simultaneous attack. If the ally who dies is the guarded ally, the attack is a guaranteed critical. (Judge)
Magic attack against all enemies with damage increased based on current influence and justice value. (Judge)
Magic attack that deals damage and generates influence over all enemies based on current justice value. (Judge)
Melee attack that causes mana burn on the target. (Judge)
Summons a giant owl as a mount companion. (Judge)
Magic attack against all enemies, usable only on the turn after an enemy dies. (Judge)
Move: Any enemy that attacks the target unit is delayed. (Judge)
Commands an ally to attack the enemy that killed an ally on the previous turn. (Judge)
Compels all enemies over which the Judge has influence to attack her. (Judge)
Melee attack with justice against the enemy that killed an ally on the previous turn. (Judge)
Enhances the Judge’s defense against the next attack. Any damage reduced by this defense is converted into a damage shield. (Judge)
The next instance of damage dealt to a target ally is converted to illusory damage instead. (Judge)
Possesses a target enemy that attacks the guarded ally, forcing it to act against its own side. (Judge)
Possesses the enemy that killed an ally on the previous turn and forces it to attack another enemy. (Judge)
Incapacitates a single target. Requires threshold. (Judge)

Threshold ability. Possesses a target ally. (Judge)

Disenchants a target enemy and causes mana loss in response to an ally dying. (Judge)

classSkills: Guarded Reaction, Attack and Mana Gain

capstone.name: Punishing Witness
capstone.text: Whenever an ally is struck by a critical hit, the Judge triggers a their ally death skill. Default effect: quickens the Judge. The triggered effect can be replaced through effect skills.

passives: Justice increases the value of justice effects, causing more damage and greater effects based on the difference between the user and target’s health.
Block chance increases the chance for the unit to block attacks by the enemy.
Retaliation increases the damage dealt by retaliation effects.
Mana damage increases the damage dealt by the unit to a target’s mana.
Mounted defense reduces the damage taken by the unit while mounted.
Ignore critical gives the unit a chance to take only regular damage from an attack that would otherwise be a critical hit.

Block amount increases the amount of damage blocked by the unit when it successfully blocks.
Mounted damage increases the damage of any attack made while mounted by an additive percentage.  If the specific attack has a mounted tag, this bonus is applied twice.
Fire power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the fire tag.

name: Totemist
description: A spirit-channeling earth fighter who pours anguish and runic power into totem companions. His totems shield allies, taunt enemies, and absorb punishment to generate more anguish, while his earth strikes hit hard and wide. Runic Rage lets him burn rune uses freely at the cost of losing them all when the wrath ends.

Major: Melee attack that costs mana with clobbering and a chance to proc maximum damage. (Totemist)
Creates a totem companion that makes a melee attack each turn and enhances the Totemist’s melee damage while active. (Totemist)
Earth melee attack against a single target with a chance to proc earth damage against all enemies. (Totemist)
Earth melee attack with increased maximum damage. (Totemist)
Earth magic attack against an enemy with earth vulnerability that also deals earth damage to all enemies. (Totemist)
Creates a totem companion based on current anguish. The totem’s damage increases with the Totemist’s anguish. (Totemist)
Creates a totem companion constructed from a primed defense rune, a primed damage rune, and a primed power rune. (Totemist)
Melee attack that procs earth empowerment on the Totemist. (Totemist)
Earth magic storm attack. Can be sustained at reduced cost to repeat. (Totemist)
Melee attack with clobbering that also strikes two random additional enemies with clobbering. (Totemist)
Summons a duplicate of the current totem companion for every ally. (Totemist)
Element rune. Untyped magic attack against a single target with life drain. (Totemist)
Move: Generates anguish based on the total damage the current totem companion has taken. (Totemist)
Establishes a pain link and heal siphon between the Totemist and the companion until the Totemist’s next turn. (Totemist)
Summons a totem companion that deals air damage to a random enemy whenever any enemy uses a magic attack. (Totemist)
Summons a totem companion that grants a damage shield to all allies on each of its turns. (Totemist)
Summons a totem companion that quickens a random ally on each of its turns. (Totemist)
Summons a totem companion that taunts a random enemy on each of its turns. (Totemist)
Summons a totem companion that enhances the elemental resistance and elemental power of all allies. (Totemist)
Minor: Commands the current totem companion to make an attack against a target enemy. (Totemist)
The Totemist’s next rune proc does not consume a use from the rune. (Totemist)
Heals the current companion and delays it. (Totemist)
While this wrath is active, the Totemist does not lose uses from runes and has an increased chance to proc them. When this wrath ends, all runes are lost and the Totemist becomes cursed. (Totemist)
The current totem companion provokes all enemies. (Totemist)
Consumes anguish to grant the current companion a damage shield. (Totemist)

capstone.name: Totem Pole
capstone.text: Totem abilities stack with one another, building a single large companion that offers multiple combined buffs rather than replacing the previous totem.

Companion health increases the maximum health of a summoned companion.  Companion health has a greater increase than companion power.
Clobbering increases the clobber value of clobbering abilities.
Summoning speed reduces the cast time of abilities with the summon tag.

Companion damage increases the damage of a summoned companion.  Companion damage has a greater increase than companion power.
Enchant power increases the value of all enchant abilities used by the unit.

Companion power increases all statistics of a summoned companion.
Damage shield increases the value of any damage shield ability used by the unit.
Earth power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the earth tag.
Enchant duration increases the duration of enchant effects used by the unit.

name: Vivisectionist
description: A precision attrition fighter who bleeds enemies out and finishes them with ruthless damage. He spends advantage on burst attacks and hidden-enabled backstabs, converts spirit power into poison shots and mass dark damage, and uses bleeds as setup — reducing the ruthless threshold so enemies already bleeding are always closer to an instant kill.

Major: Afflicts the target with an untyped bleed and deals ranged damage to all other enemies. (Vivisectionist)
Ranged attack against a bleeding target with enhanced damage based on the number of bleeds currently on it. (Vivisectionist)
Melee attack that causes bleed and stuns the target. (Vivisectionist)
Ranged attack that causes both untyped and dark bleed and applies venomous. Consumes advantage. (Vivisectionist)
Melee attack with a chance to proc maximum damage. (Vivisectionist)
Ranged attack that afflicts the target with dark vulnerability on a critical hit. (Vivisectionist)
Melee attack against a target suffering from contagion. (Vivisectionist)
Melee attack against a hidden enemy. Consumes advantage to deal ruthless damage. (Vivisectionist)
Melee attack with ruthless. On kill, stuns all remaining enemies. (Vivisectionist)
Ruthless dark magic attack against all enemies. (Vivisectionist)
Dark magic attack against all enemies. The Vivisectionist gains hidden. Consumes spirit power. (Vivisectionist)
Ranged attack with venomous. Consumes spirit power. (Vivisectionist)
Piercing dark bleed against all enemies. (Vivisectionist)
Move: Afflicts a bleeding enemy with speed weakness. (Vivisectionist)
Spends health to gain advantage. Backbiting. (Vivisectionist)
Following a ruthless attack against an enemy, deals a bleed based on the ruthless damage dealt. (Vivisectionist)
Following a ruthless attack, the Vivisectionist gains a dark damage add. (Vivisectionist)
Grants the Vivisectionist a poison that deals additional damage and ruthless damage. (Vivisectionist)

The Vivisectionist gains hidden following a ruthless attack. (Vivisectionist)
Spirit buff. Lowers the damage threshold required to trigger ruthless damage. Consumes additional spirit power whenever ruthless damage is dealt. (Vivisectionist)

capstone.text: Enemies suffering from bleed have a reduced ruthless damage threshold against the Vivisectionist.

Ignore disarm gives the unit a chance to ignore any disarm effect caused on them.

name: Drifter
description: Focused martial artist who channels inner stillness into ranged precision. Gains and spends focus through movement and form transitions, using it to fuel accurate and critical ranged attacks, counter incoming fire, and support allies — with chakra position and ammunition running as parallel systems that reward switching between them.

Major: Melee attack requiring crane form that grants enchantments based on open chakras: focus, haste, intangible, enhanced counter, enhanced dodge, air empowered, and air shielded. Sets form to monkey on hit and lowers form on miss. (Drifter)
Ranged attack that expends focus to increase critical chance and critical damage. (Drifter)
Ranged attack requiring focus that consumes focus and disarms on critical. (Drifter)
Ranged attack that requires focus, with increased accuracy and critical chance. (Drifter)
Ranged attack that grants focus on critical strike. (Drifter)
Consume all ammo to make that number of random ranged attacks. (Drifter)
Melee attack requiring focus with amplification. Amplification ends when focus is lost. (Drifter)
Ranged attack with blessed damage. Requires the Drifter to be focused. (Drifter)
Ranged attack that expends focus to strike a second random target. (Drifter)
Unerring melee attack that requires snake form and raises form on use. Enhances accuracy. (Drifter)
Summons a companion that lasts for a duration based on ammunition used and grants retaliation effects to allies. (Drifter)
Move: Consume all chakras to cause the next several counters to hit twice. (Drifter)
Expends focus to guarantee the next attack is countered. (Drifter)
Grants air retaliation that increases over time and resets each time it activates. Requires dragon form. (Drifter)
Infusion that can be detonated to apply focus. (Drifter)
Sacrifice focus to heal an ally. (Drifter)
Counter the next ranged attack, consuming ammo and with effect based on ammo type. (Drifter)
Illuminates target enemy and focuses the Drifter. Requires Third Eye form and moves to Heart form. (Drifter)
Focuses the entire team. Consumes water ammo. (Drifter)

Consumes ammo to grant an ally dodge enhancement and hidden. (Drifter)
Gain focus if in Third Eye form and move to Heart form. (Drifter)
Expend focus when next attacked to become intangible against that attack. (Drifter)
Gain focus if the Drifter dodged since last turn. (Drifter)

capstone.name: Centered Flow
capstone.text: Whenever the Drifter gains focus while already focused, he generates mana and is quickened.

Shielded power increases the value of elemental shields used by the unit and on the unit.  This can stack.
Empowered power increases the value of elemental empowerments used by the unit and on the unit.  This can stack.
Quickens increases the quicken effect of any ability used by the unit.
Conserve focus grants a unit a chance to not lose focus when it prevents disruption or is used for an ability.

name: Valkyrie
description: A storm-riding mounted warrior who fills the battlefield with cascading air damage. She builds momentum for countdowns, chains storm attacks through the Reiteration family's delayed follow-up hits, and with Rolling Thunder every storm strike carries a chance to echo again as a weaker random hit — ensuring the storm never truly stops.

Major: Trigger rune. Deals air damage against a single target. Causes the next air attacks to deal storm damage to a number of random targets based on a lower number of uses remaining. (Valkyrie)
Taunts the enemy and converts its damage to air. Reflects the next air damage from the target to all enemies. (Valkyrie)
Air countdown versus a single target with duration and damage dependent on momentum. (Valkyrie)
Melee attack that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)
Air melee attack that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)
Air magic attack with delay that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)

Move: Lesser magic air attack and compel versus the challenged. (Valkyrie)
Grants the target a disruption proc. (Valkyrie)

Follows a storm attack. The target struck is afflicted with air exposure. (Valkyrie)
Restores all active reiterating abilities to their maximum number of uses. (Valkyrie)
Single target compel that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)
Gains mana and quickens self when next hit by a storm ability. (Valkyrie)

Grants an air damage add to the next attack. Requires momentum. (Valkyrie)
The next storm ability hits the same target with two of its attacks. (Valkyrie)
Until the Valkyrie's next turn, all storm abilities that hit the Valkyrie also hit her challenge. (Valkyrie)
Gains an air damage add to the next attack after taking damage from a storm ability. (Valkyrie)

passives: Air power increases the damage and effectiveness of any ability with the air tag.
Proc power increases the damage and effectiveness of all proc abilities of the unit.
Mounted damage increases the damage of any attack made while mounted by an additive percentage.  If the specific attack has a mounted tag, this bonus is applied twice.
Countdown power increases the value of countdown effects used by the unit.
Air piercing reduces the effectiveness of a target’s air resistance against the unit’s abilities.
Mounted speed increases the speed of the unit while mounted.
Air adds increases air damage which is added to attacks.
Momentum increases the value of abilities with the momentum modifier, gaining increased power from counter above 1000.
Magic resistance decreases the damage and effects taken from offensive magic abilities.
Piercing reduces the effectiveness of an enemy’s magic resistance in protecting against spells.
Penetration increases the amount of armor ignored by penetrate abilities.  If penetration exceeds 100%, the damage is increased by the left-over percentage.
